corrections.corrected_text: በቍርጥ ፡ ፍርድ ፡ ቀን ፡ ከእሱ ፡ ዘንድ ፡ ባለ
corrections.reason: The word ባለሟልነትን splits across the line break from line 2 (ባለ) to line 3 (ሟልነትን).
The printed text clearly reads ወኢያብላዕክሙ (without -ኒ) followed by አሰኝታ (with 1st-order አ and ሰ, matching Col 3 L09 አሰኝታ), not እስኝታ.
The glyph has the top loop of 7th-order ጾ (ለቢጾ, matching ቢጾ in Col 3 L26 and Col 4 L08) rather than a right-leg ጹ.
